 SMART to provide free rides to the polls on Election Day
 Service includes all SMART transit options on Nov. 3.
 Noelle Gray , Producer
 Published:  October 28, 2026 at 1:21 PM Tags:  Wayne County , Macomb County , Oakland County , Decision 2026 Pictured: FAST Smart bus DETROIT – The Suburban Mobility Authority for Regional Transportation (SMART) will offer free transit service to all riders throughout Oakland, Macomb and Wayne counties on Election Day, Tuesday, Nov. 3.
 According to a release, free rides will be available all day on Election Day across all SMART transit services in the three counties including:
 Recommended Videos
 Fixed Route: Regularly scheduled routes, picking up and dropping off riders at designated stops across Southeast Michigan. 
 Connector Services: Curb-to-curb service available with an advance reservation. 
 ADA Paratransit: Curb-to-curb service for eligible riders with disabilities. 
 SMART Flex: On-demand rideshare service in Dearborn, Troy/Clawson, Auburn Hills/Pontiac, Hall Road, and Farmington/Farmington Hills and Northern Macomb. 
 Riders planning to use Connector Services or ADA Paratransit on Election Day should make advance reservations.
 “Election Day is a day when every resident should have the opportunity to participate, and transportation shouldn’t stand in the way,” said Tiffany J. Gunter, General Manager and CEO of SMART. “By offering free rides on every SMART service November 3rd, we’re meeting where they are and making sure that every resident across Oakland, Macomb and Wayne counties has a reliable way to make their voice heard.”
 The Detroit Department of Transportation, DDOT will also be offering free fares on Election Day.
 For more information about route schedules, bus stop locations and more riders can visit www.smartmovesus.org or call SMART Customer Service at 866-962-5515.
